prior_art_found: LLM-based livestock disease diagnosis + treatment-recommendation frameworks for farmers already exist (IJCA Oyelade 2025; Farmer.Chat arXiv 2409.08916; AIEP arXiv 2601.11537) — weakens the 'no decision-support tooling / novel framing' claim for livestock advisory broadly.

Offline / on-device clinical LLM advisors already exist (Pocket RAG offline first-aid arXiv 2602.13229; Offline-First LLM arXiv 2603.03339; quantized-LLM-on-phones arXiv 2312.12472) — directly weakens technique novelty: 'offline on-device medical advisor' is not new.

Generative-AI / LLM tooling for traditional medicine, including envisioned multilingual mobile chat advisors and domain-tuned models (TCMChat; 'Reimagining ethnopharmacology with generative AI' S104366182500427X) — same conceptual framing, applied to human ethnopharmacology rather than ethnoveterinary livestock dosing.

BitNet ternary on-device LLMs are explicitly positioned for edge/offline healthcare deployment (BitNet b1.58 report arXiv 2504.12285; InfoQ) — the enabling capability is established and already pointed at the healthcare-edge use case generically.
NOT FOUND: the exact pairing of a ternary + N:M-structured-sparse on-device LLM instruct-tuned on an ETHNOVETERINARY corpus for livestock dosing/diagnosis on a rural offline phone.
verdict_reason: The precise application — a 1.58-bit + structured-sparse on-device LLM tuned on an ethnoveterinary corpus for offline livestock dosing — was not found, so the exact corpus+technique pairing is genuinely unclaimed. However, the gap is clearly NARROW rather than OPEN: per the candidate-8 caution, (1) offline/on-device clinical LLM advisors broadly exist (Pocket RAG, offline-first quantized LLMs), so the technique's headline 'offline edge medical advisor' capability is not novel; (2) LLM livestock-disease advisors for smallholders already exist; and (3) generative-AI tooling for traditional/indigenous medicine with multilingual chat advisors is an active, published framing (TCMChat, ethnopharmacology-GenAI). The novelty is reduced to the specific ethnoveterinary corpus plus the particular Sparse-BitNet quantization recipe, not the problem or capability. Not GAP_CLOSED because no source applies this technique-class (or an equivalent on-device LLM) to the ethnoveterinary corpus itself.

prior_art_found: Learned / deep-learning dead-reckoning and inertial state estimation is a mature field (Deep Learning for Inertial Positioning survey arXiv 2303.03757; AI-IMU Dead-Reckoning arXiv 1904.06064; DL-assisted inertial DR arXiv 2407.16387) — weakens the claim that casting dead-reckoning as learned sequential state estimation is itself novel; but all are IMU/pedestrian/vehicle, not the star-compass+swell mental method.

Machine-learning / deep-learning star & constellation pattern recognition for (instrumented) celestial navigation exists (multi-kernel SVM IEEE 5599814; DL constellation recognition ACM 3783669.3783762) — adjacent ML-for-celestial-navigation, but automated optical star ID, not the traditional 32-house mental compass integration.

Cognitive-science and conceptual computational models of traditional/indigenous wayfinding exist (Trends in Cognitive Sciences ocean/tundra review incl. etak; MAGELLAN; AAAI cognitive wayfinding model) — academic interest in modeling the navigator's cognition exists, but as conceptual/cognitive-map models, not learned SSM state estimators fed by sky-camera/IMU/swell-buoy streams.

NOT FOUND: any Mamba / state-space-model application to Polynesian (or Micronesian) wayfinding, and no learned sequential state-estimation model of the star-compass-plus-swell dead-reckoning method specifically. The one 'Mamba + navigation' hit (arXiv 2406.16722) is a metaphorical-title false positive.
verdict_reason: No source applies Mamba/any SSM to Polynesian wayfinding, and no learned, sensor-driven state-estimation model of the traditional star-compass+swell method exists — so this specific technique+domain pairing is genuinely new. However, the domain problem is NOT essentially untouched, which rules out GAP_OPEN: (1) learned dead-reckoning / inertial state estimation (the candidate's core capability framing) is a mature, heavily published area (AI-IMU, DL inertial-positioning survey); (2) ML/DL star-and-constellation recognition for celestial navigation exists; and (3) cognitive-science and conceptual computational models of traditional wayfinding (including Pacific etak) already attempt to model the navigator's integration. Thus 'sequential state estimation for navigation' and 'computationally modeling traditional wayfinding' are both occupied at the framing level. Not GAP_CLOSED because none of these is the SSM-on-Polynesian-wayfinding application nor a directly equivalent learned model of the star-compass+swell method itself.
